timeline.summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
timeline.quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie tells Giada and Kitt that they are going to change the plane.
timeline.quote: "Good, because in no time at all, we're going to change the plane."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt Kanto takes Elspeth to Jinnie, who agrees to give her a few small jobs for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "Then I think I have a few small jobs for you.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth works the floor at the Crescendo, where Jinnie, Kitt and Giada approach her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth stood on the dance floor of the Vantoleone with a platter in hand.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads Giada onstage as Maestros begin to move through the crowd, and Elspeth senses something wrong.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada touches an enormous empty bottle and it fills with Halo, which Jinnie presents as the Font, Halo made from nothing.
timeline.quote: we have made Halo from nothing .

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary's infiltrators reveal themselves at the Crescendo; revelers throw off their family signets and draw weapons, and the Halo bottle is dropped.
timeline.quote: No family was exempt from infiltration by the Adversary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie abandons Giada on stage to rush to Jetmir, who is cornered and outnumbered.
timeline.quote: Jinnie leapt into the fray, weapons drawn, leaving Giada behind.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
timeline.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
timeline.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
timeline.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
timeline.quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
timeline.quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Obscura enforcers ambush them in the park; Kamiz's trap is revealed and Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee as Jinnie fights.
timeline.quote: This had all been a setup.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Discovered by Cabaretti scouts, Giada is found able to turn sewage into pure Halo and the Cabaretti keep her secret.
timeline.quote: she could turn even the foulest city sewage into pure Halo

citation.work: Giada
citation.text: "Giada", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Crescendo celebration, Jetmir is gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary and tended to by his adopted daughter in an Obscura safehouse.
timeline.quote: Jetmir was gravely wounded by agents of the Adversary

citation.work: Jetmir
citation.text: "Jetmir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Siding with the Adversary, Kamiz was wounded by Jinnie Fay after an ambush.
timeline.quote: she was wounded by Jinnie Fay after attempting an ambush following the Crescendo attack

citation.work: Kamiz
citation.text: "Kamiz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: But that was what fathers were supposed to do, even the adoptive kind.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

relations.note: Leads Jinnie into a trap, serving the Adversary's side.
relations.quote: Jinnie had no doubt turned her rage on Kamiz immediately upon realizing her deception.
